  "check_code": "import re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    root = Path(ws)\n    for p in (root / 'system/sharepoint_tax_evidence_vault/state.db', root.parent / 'system/sharepoint_tax_evidence_vault/state.db'):\n        if p.exists(): return sqlite3.connect(p)\n    raise FileNotFoundError('sharepoint_tax_evidence_vault state.db not found')\n\ndef _v3(c):\n    return c.execute(\"SELECT * FROM evidence_documents WHERE logical_document_id='LDOC-RESPONSE-LETTER' AND version_no=3 AND current_version_flag=1\").fetchone()\n\ndef _rows(c, doc_id):\n    names=[x[1] for x in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(evidence_pages)')]\n    return [dict(zip(names,r)) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM evidence_pages WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY page_number',(doc_id,))]\n\ndef check_version_transition(ws):\n    c=_db(ws)\n    try:\n        r=_v3(c); p=c.execute(\"SELECT document_id,version_no,current_version_flag,retention_status FROM evidence_documents WHERE document_id='DOC-SP-2024-0068'\").fetchone()\n        if not r or not p: return {'score':0,'detail':'current version 3 or predecessor is missing'}\n        names=[x[1] for x in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(evidence_documents)')]; d=dict(zip(names,r))\n        ok=d['prior_version_document_id']=='DOC-SP-2024-0068' and d['signature_status']=='UNSIGNED' and d['logical_document_id']=='LDOC-RESPONSE-LETTER' and p[1:]==(2,0,'SUPERSEDED')\n        return {'score':int(ok),'detail':'version 3 current and version 2 superseded' if ok else 'version chain or unsigned state is incorrect'}\n    finally: c.close()\n\ndef check_page_controls(ws):\n    c=_db(ws)\n    try:\n        r=_v3(c)\n        if not r: return {'score':0,'detail':'version 3 is not current'}\n        names=[x[1] for x in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(evidence_documents)')]; doc=dict(zip(names,r)); pages=_rows(c,doc['document_id']); n=5\n        valid=len(pages)==n and [p['page_number'] for p in pages]==list(range(1,n+1))\n        valid=valid and all(p['tin_reference_id']=='TINREF-SC-4817' and p['tax_year_marked_flag']==1 and p['photocopy_flag']==1 and p['ocr_status']=='COMPLETE' and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',p['content_sha256'] or '') for p in pages)\n        missing=sum(1 for p in pages if not p['tin_marked_flag'])\n        detail=f'{len(pages)} contiguous pages registered; {missing} TIN-marking readiness exception(s) preserved'\n        return {'score':int(valid),'detail':detail if valid else 'page inventory or required page controls are incomplete'}\n    finally: c.close()\n\ndef check_upload_custody(ws):\n    c=_db(ws)\n    try:\n        r=_v3(c)\n        if not r: return {'score':0,'detail':'version 3 is not current'}\n        e=c.execute(\"SELECT event_type,event_status,actor_entity_id,checksum_verified_flag FROM custody_events WHERE document_id=? AND event_type='UPLOAD' ORDER BY event_at DESC,custody_event_id DESC LIMIT 1\",(r[0],)).fetchone()\n        ok=e and e[1]=='COMPLETED' and e[2]=='PREPARER-HANNAH-BROOKS-EA-001' and e[3]==1\n        return {'score':int(bool(ok)),'detail':'completed Hannah Brooks upload custody event exists' if ok else 'required upload custody event is missing or incorrect'}\n    finally: c.close()\n\ndef check_historical_integrity(ws):\n    c=_db(ws)\n    try:\n        p=c.execute(\"SELECT logical_document_id,prior_version_document_id,version_no,signature_status,title FROM evidence_documents WHERE document_id='DOC-SP-2024-0068'\").fetchone(); e=c.execute(\"SELECT event_type,event_at FROM custody_events WHERE custody_event_id='CUST-2024-0306' AND document_id='DOC-SP-2024-0068'\").fetchone()\n        ok=p==(\"LDOC-RESPONSE-LETTER\",\"DOC-SP-2024-0052\",2,\"SIGNED\",\"CP2000 disagreement response letter draft v2 - revised issue 2\") and e==(\"SIGNATURE_INVALIDATED\",\"2024-10-08T14:52:41Z\")\n        return {'score':int(ok),'detail':'historical version and invalidation event preserved' if ok else 'historical evidence was altered'}\n    finally: c.close()\n"
